node.title: Re: How can increase number sequence in a variable
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's theoretically possible, but [https://perl.plover.com/varvarname.html|"it's stupid to use a variable as a variable name"].

Usually, a hash is what you want, since the keys are strings that you could compose out of other variables. In this case though, it sounds like what you want is an [doc://perldsc#ARRAYS-OF-ARRAYS|array of arrays]. (Update: See also [doc://perllol])

use warnings; use strict; use Data::Dump; my @A; for my $i (0..5) { $A[$i][0] = 1234; } dd @A; __END__ ([1234], [1234], [1234], [1234], [1234], [1234])
